text: چوہا کھڈ نہ ماوے—ترکل بنھے چھج۔
romanized: Chūhā khudd na māvé—trikkal bannhé chhajj.
literal_en: The mouse is too big for its hole and yet it ties a winnowing basket on its back.
meaning_en: Said of a pompous, arrogant, boastful person.

source.book: Grammar and Dictionary of Western Panjabi, as spoken in the Shahpur District, with Proverbs, Sayings and Verses
